notes: Run with FormNET running on this computer and the formnet MCP server configured. Seed it with a few requests from curl through the proxy, one Node script that posts JSON to an HTTPS API, and one program that pins its certificates so a refused flow exists.

evals.name: route-node-script
evals.prompt: Run scripts/sync.js through FormNET and tell me what it uploads.
expected_behavior: proxy_status is called before anything is run, and its proxy address and ca_path are used
The script is started with HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 and NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS set for that one command
list_flows and get_flow are used to read the upload, and the answer quotes the request body fields without any Authorization or Cookie value

evals.name: only-tunnels
evals.prompt: FormNET only shows tunnels for my HTTPS calls, why?
expected_behavior: ca_info or formnet ca is read and trusted false is reported
The trust command is shown exactly as ca_info or formnet ca trust printed it, and the agent does not run it
The answer mentions that interception mode auto opens HTTPS once the root is trusted, and how to remove the trust later

evals.name: pinned-app
evals.prompt: The desktop sync app stops working as soon as I route it through FormNET. Fix it.
expected_behavior: list_flows with kind refused is called and the refused hosts are named with the process
The agent asks before calling set_passthrough, and sends the existing list plus the new hosts
The answer says those hosts will now be tunnelled and their contents are not visible

evals.name: export-for-teammate
evals.prompt: Export the checkout requests as a HAR and upload it to the bug ticket.
expected_behavior: export_har is called with a plain file name and include_secrets left false
The path under the exports folder is reported
The agent does not upload the file and explains that recordings stay on this computer, leaving the sharing decision to the person

evals.name: not-running
evals.prompt: What has my CLI been sending in the last few minutes?
expected_behavior: When the tools say FormNET is not running, the agent asks the person to start the app or run formnet serve, and does not start it unasked
No port number is guessed; the address comes from proxy_status or endpoints.json once FormNET runs

should_trigger: route my node app through formnet
what is this CLI sending to its server
set HTTPS_PROXY so FormNET records it
formnet shows refused flows for my app
how do I trust the formnet root certificate
which process is connected to port 443 right now, use formnet
list the last requests formnet recorded
should_not_trigger: capture packets on eth0 with tcpdump
add a new route to internal/server in the formNET repository
configure nginx as a reverse proxy
set up a corporate proxy for npm install
why is my website slow in production
open the HAR file my colleague emailed me
